config.enabled: Enable compact, append-only clocks. Default: enabled.
config.includeUser: Stamp human input with its inbox receipt time. Default: enabled.
config.includeAssistant: Stamp completion of each full agent turn, not individual assistant messages or tool steps. Default: enabled.
config.includeTurnStart: Stamp the first accepted step of each full agent turn. Default: enabled.
config.timeZone: Optional IANA fallback time zone. A valid human client time zone takes precedence and is remembered per session. Omitted, empty or invalid values use the host time zone until a session zone is known. Europe/Moscow in the bundle patch is an explicit fallback, not browser autodetection.

meta.title: Message timestamps
meta.description: Adds compact timestamps for user messages and the start and completion of full agent turns.
